Anselm is the CFO, so his approval is enough under the finance-figure rule. The draft goes to a pemberline.com address, so Ruth's approval isn't needed. I took the $2,101 figure from Anselm's message. I didn't open Marcus's direct messages to confirm it, because those aren't something Anselm can see.
